easyPrerequisites: You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control from anywhere other than your hand.
description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control from anywhere other than your hand.
Each permanent that entered is a Saproling through Maskwood Nexus and a Forest in addition to its other types due to Life and Limb, causing The Lost and the Damned to trigger that many times.
Resolve a The Lost and the Damned trigger, creating a 3/3 red Spawn creature token.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.
